title: Runaway avalanches in plasmas with external electric fields: spatially inhomogeneous case in a perturbation framework
summary: We consider the Landau-Coulomb equation for a (hydrogen) plasma heated by an external electric field. In this setting, theoretical and experimental results in plasma physics show the emergence of so-called \emph{runaway electrons} which are linearly accelerating but only lead to a minimal increase of the plasma temperature. Runaway electrons are a major obstacle in nuclear fusion since they can overcome the confinement and damage the structure of the reactor.
